overview_description.description: YQNLink specializes in digital logistics, providing a comprehensive suite of international logistics services. This includes sea freight, air freight, rail freight, and multimodal transportation solutions. With a focus on leveraging digital technology, YQNLink aims to enhance supply chain transparency and efficiency, making shipping processes simpler for businesses. The company offers consultative services to tailor logistics solutions to specific business needs, ensuring a streamlined and effective logistics strategy. YQNLink's acquisition of COPE, a cross-border e-commerce logistics firm, further expands its capabilities in serving the e-commerce sector.
